name: matrix_utils
description: Dense matrix helpers with exact Fraction arithmetic: construction, transpose, product, power, determinant, inverse and linear solve.
bugs: zeros() repeats one row object ([[0] * cols] * rows), so every row aliases the same list
matmul() runs the inner sum over the row count of a instead of its column count
determinant() does not flip the sign when it swaps rows to find a pivot
